User.title: User
User.description: Authenticated Nafis Noor user profile, security role, and spiritual progress stats

id.description: The unique Firebase Auth user ID matching the document ID

email.description: User email address (PII isolated to owner and admin)

photoURL.description: Optional user profile avatar photo URL

isNewUser.description: Flag indicating if this is a newly registered user or returning user

loginCount.description: Monotonically increasing count of user sign-ins

createdAt.description: Immutable ISO timestamp when the user account was first created

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent login

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when data was last updated

role.description: RBAC security role; non-admins can only create as 'user' and cannot self-escalate

stats.description: Persistent Noor Islamic user stats, streaks, bookmarks, XP, and preferences

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Private Noor AI conversation thread belonging strictly to a single user

userId.description: Owner user Auth UID matching parent /users/{userId}

messages.description: Bounded list of conversation messages (max 200 messages)

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator lookup document for RBAC verification

grantedAt.description: ISO timestamp when admin role was provisioned

FeedbackSubmission.title: FeedbackSubmission
FeedbackSubmission.description: User or guest feedback and suggestion submission stored permanently for founder review

email.description: Optional submitter email address for receiving replies (PII protected)

language.description: App language code at time of submission

status.description: Review status managed by authorized administrators

isResolved.description: Whether the feedback or issue has been marked resolved by an administrator

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when status or reply was last updated

repliedAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp when administrator replied

repliedBy.description: Optional administrator identifier who sent the reply

/users/{userId}.description: Isolated per-user profile and spiritual progress document. Accessible only by the owner (request.auth.uid == userId) or verified admin.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Private Noor AI conversation history subcollection. Accessible only by the parent user owner.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Read-only trusted administrator registry managed strictly by system administrators.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Permanent user and guest feedback submissions. Creation allowed for valid Pending submissions; reading, status updates, and replies restricted to verified administrators (or the authenticated submitter for their own records).
